newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The Indonesian government will ground the remaining British-made ATP turboprop aircraft operated by state-owned Merpati Nusantara Airlines after one of the planes crashed on Saturday on Belitung. Fifteen people were killed in the accident and 31 injured.

An automotive industry analyst said Indonesia has a slim chance of winning when Japan takes its national car policy before a panel of judges at the World Trade Centre Organisation (WTO) later this month. The policy exempts cars produced by PT Timor Putra Nasional, controlled by President Suharto's son Hutomo Mandala Putra, from import duties and luxury taxes.

Ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party Megawati Sukarnoputri has issued a political manifesto which said that bureaucratic incompetence may lead to national disintegration. She said Indonesia faces growing national disintegration triggered by nepotism and the bureaucratic incompetence.
